:::{#def-cauchy-sequence}
#### Cauchy sequence

A [sequence](functions.qmd#def-sequence) $(\vx_n)$ of vectors in a [real inner product space](linear-algebra-inner-products.qmd#def-inner-product-space) $V$
is a **Cauchy sequence**
[@wikipedia_cauchy_sequence]
if for every $\tolout > 0$ there is a [natural number](number-systems.qmd#def-natural-numbers) $N$ such that

$$\norm{\vx_m - \vx_n} < \tolout \quad \text{for all } m, n \ge N,$$

where $\norm{\vx} = \sqrt{\iprod{\vx}{\vx}}$ for every $\vx \in V$.

:::
